points.point: How to make a carousel from Videos templates
points.sentence: Go to Videos > Create New Video and select a carousel or slideshow template, for example Image Slideshow with Text Overlays.

points.point: Use my brand details in the carousel (Brand Kit applied to Videos templates)

verdict.reason: The make-carousel-slideshow entry covers how to create a carousel, but no sentence in any entry says that Brand Kit details are applied to Videos template carousels; brand-kit-setup only says Brand Kit stores business, audience, and style context, which is not an answer to the question.
